title: Intuit agrees to sell marketing subsidiary Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68B in cash and stock; Intuit paid $12B to buy Mailchimp in 2021 (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary: Jordan Novet / CNBC: Intuit agrees to sell marketing subsidiary Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68B in cash and stock; Intuit paid $12B to buy Mailchimp in 2021 — Tax software maker Intuit said Thursday that it has agreed to sell marketing subsidiary Mailchimp to Italian technology consolidator Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion in cash and stock.
